tools.name: regsta_list_employees
tools.description: List the company's employees with their active state, login flag, employee number, latest shift date and configured contact details (email, phone). Regsta API: GET /api/v1/employees (scope employees:read).

tools.name: regsta_list_shifts
tools.description: List time records (worked shifts) with their start and end times, pause and work minutes, source and status. Optional from/to dates filter by company calendar day. Regsta API: GET /api/v1/shifts (scope shifts:read).

tools.name: regsta_list_schedule
tools.description: List the published and cancelled planned shifts (the rota) for a date range. Drafts, internal notes, cancellation reasons and vehicle plates are not returned. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: regsta_list_employees · Private data: regsta_list_employees, regsta_list_shifts · Public sink: regsta_list_employees.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: regsta_list_employees · Private data: regsta_list_employees, regsta_list_shifts · Public sink: regsta_list_employees

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
